1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube near the bottom surface of the test tube.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube substantially along the central axis of the bottom portion.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded beneath, oriented for reading downwards, and the embedding position is sufficiently defined to specify it is approximately 1 to 5 millimeters above the bottom surface.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer near the bottom surface of the test tube.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded beneath, oriented for reading downwards, and the embedding position is specified as approximately 1 to 5 millimeters above the bottom surface.
